verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Parse turns 'even the most complex layouts, tables' into clean markdown via layout-aware OCR, and can pull every table into pandas DataFrames with page provenance and handle financial tables. One user was impressed by complex-layout results, but another early hands-on user said extracted table numbers did not come out in tabular form, and the story's specific hard cases are never documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merged-cell and nested-header handling, multi-page table stitching, HTML table output, and independent corroboration of table-structure fidelity.
